headline: BNR Exchange Rate Valid 7 October 2026: Leu Weakens Sharply. 1 Euro Now Costs 5.3527 Lei
summary: The National Bank of Romania set its exchange rate for 7 October at 5.3527 lei per euro, up 0.41% from the previous day. The leu is described as weakening sharply.
why: The EUR/RON rate is the official reference for Romanian import costs, euro-denominated debt and foreign-currency exposure of Romanian banks and exporters.
